steps.label: Place tortilla on board
steps.recipe_text: Place-Place 8-inch flour tortilla on cutting board

steps.label: Scoop nut butter from jar
steps.recipe_text: scoop-Use a butter knife to scoop nut butter from the jar

steps.label: Spread nut butter on tortilla
steps.recipe_text: Spread-Spread nut butter onto the tortilla, leaving 1/2-inch uncovered at the edges

steps.label: Clean knife with towel
steps.recipe_text: Clean-Clean the knife by wiping it with a paper towel

steps.label: Scoop jelly from jar
steps.recipe_text: scoop-Use the knife to scoop jelly from the jar

steps.label: Spread jelly over butter
steps.recipe_text: Spread-Spread jelly over the nut butter

steps.label: Clean knife with towel
steps.recipe_text: Clean-Clean the knife by wiping with a paper towel

steps.label: Roll tortilla into log
steps.recipe_text: Roll-Roll the tortilla from one end to the other into a log shape, about 1.5 inches thick. Roll it tight enough to prevent gaps, but not so tight that the filling leaks

steps.label: Secure roll with toothpicks
steps.recipe_text: Secure-Secure the rolled tortilla by inserting 5 toothpicks about 1 inch apart

steps.label: Trim roll ends
steps.recipe_text: Trim-Trim the ends of the tortilla roll with the butter knife, leaving 1/2 inch margin between the last toothpick and the end of the roll

steps.label: Slide floss under roll
steps.recipe_text: Slide-Slide floss under the tortilla, perpendicular to the length of the roll

steps.label: Place floss between toothpicks
steps.recipe_text: Place-Place the floss halfway between toothpicks

steps.label: Cross floss over roll
steps.recipe_text: Cross-Cross the floss's two ends over the tortilla roll's top

steps.label: Pull floss to slice
steps.recipe_text: pull-pull the floss ends in opposite directions to slice

steps.label: Continue slicing pinwheel
steps.recipe_text: slicing-Continue slicing with floss to create 1 more pinwheel

steps.label: Place pinwheels on plate
steps.recipe_text: Place-Place the pinwheels on a plate
